review.tagline: Self-hosted agent assistant with memory, skills and many chat channels
review.summary: CowAgent is a Python agent that plans tasks, calls built-in tools (file I/O, bash, browser, scheduler, web search) and MCP servers, and replies through Web, Telegram, Slack, Discord, WeChat, Feishu, DingTalk, QQ and other channels. It keeps three-tier long-term memory, a Markdown knowledge base, installable skills and multi-agent teams. Models are configured per capability from a web console on port 9899.
review.audience: Self-hosters wanting an always-on agent reachable from chat apps
strengths: Many channels at once: Web, Telegram, Slack, Discord, WeChat, Feishu, DingTalk, QQ, WeCom
Chat, vision, image generation, ASR, TTS and embeddings can route to different providers
MCP support over stdio, SSE and Streamable HTTP, plus a skill hub and GitHub skill installs
Three-tier memory with nightly distillation and hybrid keyword and vector retrieval
weaknesses: Agent mode uses substantially more tokens than plain chat, per the README
Local models only via the Custom provider, which lists chat support only
Console is reachable externally once web_host is 0.0.0.0, so a password is needed
Hosted runtime and enterprise features are tied to the vendor's LinkAI service
needs: Needs LLM provider API key or custom model endpoint
Models: Claude, OpenAI GPT, Gemini, DeepSeek, Qwen
